children.name: A 5-slot sidebar wrapper: Top Bar, Header, Sub Header, Body (free), Footer. Two width variants (Expanded 280px / Collapsed 64px). All slots have INSTANCE_SWAP with preferred values. Body is a free drag-and-drop container.
2 variants · 5 slots · 7 component tokens · INSTANCE_SWAP per slot with preferred values
Use this component in your design — but read the workflow note before building!
How to build a functional Side Bar

Figma does NOT persist Collapsed variant overrides. When you customize the Expanded variant and switch to Collapsed, your slot content, swaps, and layout adjustments are lost. Same in reverse. You must lock each state into its own component variant.
Drag the Side Bar component into your canvas.
Set Collapsed variant to OFF (expanded). Customize all slots: pick header, drop your nav items into Body, set footer.
With your customized instance still selected: right-click → "Create component". This locks your expanded layout as a NEW master under your control.
Add a variant to YOUR new component. Switch the new variant to the Collapsed look (collapse list items, swap to icon-only buttons, hide labels).
Adjust the graphics on the collapsed variant manually until it matches what you want at 64px width.
Open the Prototype tab. Wire the chevron / collapse trigger to swap between your two variants on click.

Tip: once your two variants exist, iterate independently. The Side Bar master here stays the source of truth for slot architecture and tokens — your derived component inherits everything when instanced inside.
